name: veda-1
_base_model_note: The plan suggested DeepSeek-R1-Distill. Its chat template has no tool-calling support, and veda-1 must call search/read tools, so this uses Qwen3-14B: a reasoning model with native tool calls and the same template as axon-1/tandav-1. To use R1-Distill anyway, set base_model to deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B and update the template markers in train.py.
description: Deep research: reads docs and code, gathers context, writes cited engineering specs.
hardware: train: 1x 24GB GPU, or a Colab/Kaggle T4 at 4k context. serve: 1x 24GB GPU
